items.summary: CTO disposition: approve containment only. Do not create new proposals, telemetry, prototypes, site-factory admissions, security work, or duplicate queue requests while all 10 delivery slots are occupied and measurement/repair work remains active. Preserve existing security and launch gates; missing operations and fleet-doctor evidence does not support clearance. Complete or close the existing saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case by 2026-10-01T09:00Z with root-cause or closure evidence, deterministic tests, isolated validation, build evidence, rollback point, release boundary, attribution limits, measurement limits, and deduplication evidence. Release a slot only after that evidence is recorded; otherwise escalate to the owner.

Preserve the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as the sole next implementation after capacity clears. Do not create a replacement request. Before execution, confirm the existing site-overlap queue is consolidated and the request remains the canonical work item. Scope remains isolated to highest-intent commercial pages: CTA hierarchy, adjacent readable disclosure, preserved destination and registered tracking ID, keyboard focus, and responsive spacing; no new dependencies, credentials, configuration, tracking, or cross-site behavior.

Revenue and measurement disposition: preserve unknowns. The available Amazon record is a single aggregate, unattributed window; it does not support site revenue, ROI, margin, forecast, or causal-lift claims. Validate the CTA change with deterministic build, smoke, link/destination, keyboard-focus, and responsive checks, then use only existing outbound-click and available attribution evidence. Keep parked-site previews deferred until their existing readiness artifacts and all owner, Legal, Security, measurement, reviewer, and rollback gates are complete.

Maintain the existing consolidated security evidence matrix and private launch gates as report-only work. Continue using authorized metadata and retained artifacts; do not request duplicate telemetry, access credentials or private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or conduct external outreach. The current evidence does not support security certification or clearance.
